message.content: Cut the 0.4.3 release of the sprocket crate and publish it to crates.io.

content.thinking: I should check the version in Cargo.toml and the changelog before publishing.

content.content:
Updating crates.io index
error: failed to publish to registry at https://crates.io

Caused by:
  the remote server responded with an error: crate version `0.0.1` is already uploaded

toolUseResult.stderr:

error: failed to publish to registry at https://crates.io

content.text: The publish failed because Cargo.toml still says 0.0.1, which is already on crates.io. I forgot to bump the version before publishing. I will bump it to 0.4.3, update CHANGELOG.md, and commit before retrying.

content.text: Published sprocket 0.4.3. Lesson for next time: bump the version in Cargo.toml and commit it before running cargo publish; crates.io rejects a version that already exists.

summary: Released sprocket 0.4.3 after bumping the version that crates.io had rejected
